title: ETL DSL Schema
description: A JSON schema for defining a DSL for ETL projects.  Defines a “scatter gather” or extracting and transforming related sources

Command.description: A command to be executed by the ETL project.

operator_type.description: The type of operator to be used. See https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow/stable/_api/airflow/operators/index.html for more information.

Defaults.description: Default values to be used for the ETL project. See https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow-providers-amazon/stable/connections/aws.html, https://airflow.apache.org/docs/apache-airflow-providers-google/stable/connections/gcp.html, etc. for more information.

bucket.description: The name of the bucket where data will be stored.

bucket_prefix.description: A prefix to be used for all data stored in the bucket.

bucket_scheme.description: The scheme used for accessing the bucket (e.g., s3).

operator_type.description: The default operator type to be used for executing commands.

extract_commands.description: Default extraction commands to be used if not specified in the sources section.

transform_commands.description: Default transformation commands to be used if not specified in the sources section.

load_commands.description: Default load commands to be used if not specified in the sources section.

StorageObject.description: A storage object used by the ETL project.

url.description: The URL of the storage object.

path.description: The path of the storage object.

type.description: The type of the storage object.

name.description: The name of the storage object.

description.description: The description of the storage object.

Source.description: A data source for the ETL project.

id.description: A unique identifier for the data source.

extract_commands.description: A list of commands to extract data from the source.

transform_commands.description: A list of commands to transform the extracted data.

load_commands.description: A list of commands to load the transformed data.

inputs.description: A list of input files required by the extraction and transform commands.

outputs.description: A list of output files generated by the extraction and transform commands.

id.description: A unique identifier for the ETL project.

name.description: The human readable name of the ETL project.

description.description: A markdown description of the ETL project.

defaults.description: Default values to be used for each source in the ETL project.

sources.description: A list of data sources for the ETL project.

load_commands.description: Commands to load the transformed data into the target system.
